articles.title: Lectors
articles.introtext: Lectors are chosen from among parishioners who have the talent to effectively proclaim the Word of God at Masses.  Training is provided for adults and for young people in 7th grade or older.
articles.fulltext:
Call or e-mail the Parish Office for more information:  516-731-4220 or parish@stbernardchurch.org.  

Back to Ministries and Societies

articles.title: Consolation Ministry
articles.introtext:
St. Bernard's Consolation Ministry serves our community by accompanying grieving families as they journey in faith through the wake and funeral of a loved one.  We assist the family in planning the funeral Mass and welcome mourners to the church, we customize a Mass booklet to help mourners participate more fully, and one of our bakers gifts the family with a cake to have on hand during the days of the wake and funeral.

This ministry is done by dedicated volunteers who are selected and trained according to the gifts and talents they have to serve in this ministry.  For more information about this ministry, please e-mail Father Patrick or call him at:  (516) 731-4220 ext 121.
